verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents its own funnel building and plain-language AI answers that skip SQL and the data team, and community users report non-analysts across the team using it, so a founder can plausibly self-serve. But the docs never explicitly describe step-by-step drop-off or conversion analysis that pinpoints which activation step loses users, and the funnel evidence is a one-line mention. missing for 10: documented per-step drop-off/conversion breakdown in funnels, in-depth funnel documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of a non-analyst finding the losing activation step.

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer "which activation step loses users?" myself with funnels and drop-off analysis, without an analyst

citations.quote: Charts, dashboards, and insights. Build funnels, segment users, answer "why".
No SQL, configuring dashboards, or waiting on the data team.
Ask questions in plain language — Amplitude AI surfaces answers across all your data.
Amplitude has been the only analytics product that we've gotten the whole team using (operators, engineers, designers, product).
